name: grab_snatch
text: A person makes one quick snatching gesture with the right arm: thrust the right hand straight forwards, then immediately pull the right hand back to the middle of the chest. The right elbow first straightens fully, then bends sharply to bring the hand back close to the body. Left arm remains down. Reach and yank back.

review.notes_zh: 右手快速前伸后屈肘收回胸前，两阶段清楚，左手下垂；未包含被抢者或道具，手指没有独立合拢抓握动画。
